items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I made an LP with him. We made an LP in about 4 hours and 20 minutes.

ctx.x: It could be C minor, or C7 or whatever, it wouldn’t be no diminished this. But it was really, it was really nice. In fact there was one other period I made a record with and we went in and to show you how things can be done, now this was we were in the studio with Bill Cosby. And I made an LP with him. We made an LP in about 4 hours and 20 minutes. And we had no idea what he was going to play, and what he was gonna— there was no music, he’d tell the drummer to play me this beat [scats]. And he’d tell the bass ©…

player what to play. He say, “Now Red, you play” [scats]. Then he would have the drummer to fill up the rhythm and the other horns and the guitar, he’d give you all your parts, and then we’d play that for maybe a couple of choruses, then he’d change it around, so it would take us maybe, it would take us maybe of 20 minutes to get a song together, then we’d record it. We’d play it twice. Three times at the most. And that was it. But I mean he had all this in his head. He knew what he wanted to do, he didn’t have…
